answer: Stake on the grade. Spot checks re-run one answer in twenty. Disagreement dilutes the stake instead of splitting it, so a lazy panel earns less than a careful one. No identity audits its own recruit. A crystal of colluding accounts still needs an outside reviewer for every branch, and that reviewer's dilution is the ceiling on the farm. Cost at the end: two hundred identities need two hundred outside reviews per epoch, and the relic of the first bad panel is a signal every later panel reads.
